_comment: 2D-overlay alignment of each phone over kinect_flow.jpg, captured from calib/alignment.html. Numbers are in DISPLAY-PIXEL space of the stacked frames (not native image pixels). The sx/sy split is independent X and Y stretch. yaw/pitch/roll are CSS rotateY/rotateX/rotateZ with .stack at perspective: 1800px, so they introduce true foreshortening. skew is in addition.

_alignment_quality_notes.anna: Pure scale+translate fit (no yaw/pitch/roll/skew). Crude — anna's view is oblique so a flat affine cannot capture her perspective foreshortening of the bed. To convert to a meaningful 3D pose the alignment would need pitch added (her optical axis tilts strongly across-and-downstream).
_alignment_quality_notes.sophia: Full perspective fit: pitch=-17.5° plus separate scaleX (0.905) / scaleY (1.635) — captures the trapezoidal foreshortening of the bed as seen from the downstream end.
_alignment_quality_notes.valentine: Full perspective fit: pitch=-14°, small yaw (+0.5°), some skewX (-6°). Similar geometry to sophia — downstream end looking up the channel.
